title: Deal with suppliers under the Food and Grocery Code (large grocery businesses)
what: Large grocery businesses must deal with suppliers lawfully and in good faith, and meet the Code's rules on grocery supply agreements, variations and payments.

laws.title: Competition and Consumer (Industry Codes—Food and Grocery) Regulations 2024

sources.title: Competition and Consumer (Industry Codes—Food and Grocery) Regulations 2024
sources.quote: 4 Simplified outline of this instrument This instrument prescribes a mandatory industry code relating to the food and grocery industry. This Code regulates the conduct of large grocery businesses towards their suppliers, including by providing: (a) that they must deal with suppliers lawfully and in good faith;

sources.quote: Division 2—Contravention of industry codes 51ACB Contravention of industry codes A corporation must not, in trade or commerce, contravene an applicable industry code.
